Q8060.reason: Austin, author of The Province of Jurisprudence Determined, described jurisprudence as the philosophy of positive law, while Holland called it the formal science of positive law.

Q8095.reason: A five-month-old is in the indiscriminate attachment phase and accepts any adult without stranger wariness, while the older infants are past that phase or have insecure caregiving histories.

Q5546.reason: The fire was an accident and the smoke damage was a one-time event caused by careless upkeep of flammable residue, so negligence fits better than nuisance, trespass or strict liability.
